messages:
Alex M: Hey team :wave: I'm a new hire (started today) and I can't access the infra/grafana dashboards. Need to import a community dashboard JSON for latency traces. Anyone know the quickest path? Thanks!
Maria K: Welcome Alex! For Grafana/Datadog/Sentry you need to be in the 'observability-read' Okta group. Ask your manager to approve the access request in the onboarding form or file this short access request: https://forms.redwood.com/obs-access
Alex M: I tried the form but it asks for 'dashboard import' permission. Is that a separate approval?
Samir: Importing dashboards requires the grafana-import role (dev/staging) or an SRE to import into prod. For dev/staging you can import yourself if you have grafana-import. Quick steps:
```
1) Grafana UI -> Create -> Import
2) Paste JSON or upload file
3) Choose datasource -> set to 'redwood-traces' or 'prometheus'
4) Save and set folder (e.g., "Team / Alex M")
```
Devex-bot: FYI docs: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/grafana#importing-dashboards :point_up:
Ops-Liz: If you're trying to import into prod dashboards please open a ticket in #ops-requests and ping @Ops-Liz for a quick review. For emergency/short-lived access we can do temporary elevation via Okta with justification.
Maria K: Also add the dashboard filename / expected folder in the form to speed approval. Managers sometimes forget to approve without that detail.
Alex M: Thanks all! Filed the form and added dashboard name 'community-latency-2026.json' and tagged @Maria K. Uploaded a screenshot of the 403. :+1:
Samir: If you still see 403 after approval, logout -> SSO re-login, then clear cache. Permission propagation can take a minute.
Alex M: Re-logged and confirmed I can view the dashboards now. Can import in dev. Appreciate the help :)
